explication: Agency Agents is a local-first native desktop control surface for browsing an upstream agent-persona catalog and deploying deterministic persona files into supported coding tools. The principal workflow is catalog discovery and inspection, followed by rendering, installation, and ledger-based reconciliation; dashboard, teams, projects, settings, GitHub, and updates are supporting capabilities. The README and sampled backend excerpts establish the core data flow; frontend-to-command details and several unsampled modules are represented only where documented, so unsupported call edges are omitted.
